description: Implementation of the SiteForCookies class, handling site and scheme comparisons for cookie security policies within the net namespace.

classes.name: SiteForCookies
classes.description: Represents a site for cookie policies, including scheme and domain considerations, with methods for comparison, serialization, and scheme handling.

methods.name: SiteForCookies(const SchemefulSite& site)
methods.description: Constructs with a given SchemefulSite, converting WebSocket schemes to HTTP.

methods.name: FromWire
methods.description: Creates a SiteForCookies from wire data, verifying site match.

methods.name: FromOrigin
methods.description: Creates a SiteForCookies from a url::Origin.

methods.name: FromUrl
methods.description: Creates a SiteForCookies from a URL.

methods.name: ToDebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation for debugging.

methods.name: IsFirstParty
methods.description: Checks if a URL is first-party relative to this site.

methods.name: IsFirstPartyWithSchemefulMode
methods.description: Checks first-party status with optional schemeful consideration.

methods.name: IsEquivalent
methods.description: Checks if another SiteForCookies is equivalent to this one.

methods.name: CompareWithFrameTreeSiteAndRevise
methods.description: Compares and potentially revises the site based on another SchemefulSite.

methods.name: CompareWithFrameTreeOriginAndRevise
methods.description: Compares and revises based on a url::Origin.

methods.name: RepresentativeUrl
methods.description: Returns a representative URL for the site.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Checks if the site is null or opaque.

methods.name: MarkIfCrossScheme
methods.description: Marks the site as cross-scheme if applicable.
